Hi Josh — thanks for the details and the attachments. Sorry you're hitting this right before your PO window. A few things to check quickly:

- Organization (org) claim must match the legal entity name we have on file ("Acme Supplies, Inc."). If the Okta assertion uses a short name ("Acme"), Ivalua will reject the SSO link.
- OTPs: we sometimes see mobile carriers block the SMS OTP; try email delivery option and check spam/junk folders. If neither arrives, we can generate a one-time manual activation code.

 I'm looping in Connor to see if we can do a manual provisioning while Marcus pulls the legal entity mapping.
